prompt: I need you to review my FleetOps project. This is a Next.js fleet management system I'm building. I want you to do a full architecture review — look at the folder structure, the database schema (check supabase/migrations/), the services in src/services/, the API routes in src/app/api/, and the components in src/components/. Tell me what's good, what's missing, what needs improvement, and give me a priority-ordered development roadmap. Don't write any code — just analyze and plan.
assertions: Output includes a database analysis section with specific table/column references
Output includes an API review section evaluating endpoint design and coverage
Output includes a frontend architecture review covering component patterns and state management
Output includes a security review identifying at least one vulnerability or concern
Output includes a priority-ordered development roadmap with at least 10 tasks
Output identifies the lack of TypeScript usage in the project
Output identifies the lack of a proper API layer (server-side routes for data mutations)
Output provides specific, actionable improvement suggestions with reasoning
